notes.title: Cozy Farm Update
notes.notes:
Cozy Farm Update 🌾🎃

The pumpkins are on their way, the squash and the fall garden are just around the corner! 🍂 We’re excited to bring some cozy autumn vibes to the farm.

Sorry for the delay in updates — this cat had to move dens for a bit 🐾🏡 … but we’re back, and there’s so much more coming soon.

Stay tuned, farmers — the best season is just getting started! 🌻✨
